recipes.title: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.instructions: In a large pan, brown the ground beef. Add onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until vegetables soften. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, beef stock, and herbs. Simmer for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions. Serve sauce over pasta with grated Parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
ingredients: For dressing: 1 egg yolk, 2 anchovy fillets, 1 garlic clove, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 cup olive oil
recipes.instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Grill for 6-7 minutes per side. Let rest, then slice. For dressing, blend egg yolk, anchovies, garlic, mustard, and lemon juice. Slowly add oil while blending. In a bowl, toss lettuce with dressing, add chicken, croutons, and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water. Heat oil in a wok, add garlic and ginger. Add tofu and cook until golden. Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey, add to wok. Cook for another minute. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Bring a pot of water to simmer, add a splash of vinegar. Crack each egg into a small bowl, then slide into water. Poach for 3-4 minutes. Spread avocado on toast, top with poached egg, season with salt, pepper, and optional toppings.

recipes.title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
ingredients: Toppings: sliced fruit, granola, chia seeds, nuts
recipes.instructions: Blend berries, banana, yogurt, almond milk, and honey until smooth. Pour into a bowl. Arrange toppings artfully on top. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Stew
recipes.instructions: Toss beef with flour, salt and pepper. Heat oil in a Dutch oven, brown the meat. Remove meat, add onions and garlic, cook until softened. Add wine, scrape bottom of pot. Return meat to pot, add stock, herbs, and vegetables. Cover and simmer for 2 hours until meat is tender.

recipes.title: Quinoa Salad with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: Optional: feta cheese, toasted pine nuts
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse quinoa and cook in vegetable stock for 15 minutes. Let cool. Mix quinoa, roasted vegetables, lemon juice, and herbs. Add optional toppings if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Cream butter and sugars until smooth. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla. Dissolve baking soda in hot water, add to batter with salt. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans. Bake for about 10 minutes until edges are nicely browned.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.instructions: Heat oil in a large pot. Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic, cook until softened. Add spices and cook for 1 minute. Add lentils and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft. Stir in lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high. Toss asparagus with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper. Mix remaining oil with garlic, dill, and juice of one lemon. Season salmon with salt and pepper, brush with herb mixture. Grill salmon for 4-5 minutes per side. Grill asparagus for 3-4 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.
